messages:
Jo: Heads-up - saw several tenants with correct token counts but invoice-preview showing zero quota consumption for specific routes after the routing policy canary rolled. Link: https://console/redwood/invoice-preview (tenant samples) :eyes:
Rae: same. Looks like quota attribution (quota_key) is sometimes set to empty string. Downstream ledger joins treat empty string as null and drop rows.
canary-bot: rollout started route-routing-policy:v2 -> 8% (id=cr-2026-03-22-010) at 1715302400
metering-bot: sample raw event: {tenant: \"paperco\", tokens: 168, route: \"fast-gen\", quota_key: \"\"} -> enrichment emits quota_key=null
Chen: quick debug: v2 logic changed default behavior for unmatched route tags to return empty rather than fallback. That explains empty-string.
Jo: short-term mitigation idea: treat empty-string as \"__unmapped__\" at the first ingest hop. That preserves counts and surfaces a bucket in dashboards.
Rae: agreed. Also want a new telemetry metric: metering.quota.unmapped_rate per-route and per-tenant. Alert if >0.2% over 10m.
Chen: I can push a 3-line change to the ingest side to map empty->__unmapped__ and emit trace tag quota.unmapped=true. PR: https://git/repo/pull/1499
Jo: console change: show a checkbox on invoice-preview: \"Include unmapped quota usage (debug)\" default off, and show a small warning when unmapped is >=1% of tenant usage.
console-bot: UX ticket created #1502 - invoice-preview: unmapped quota line + toggle + helptext
Rae: follow-ups: (1) ingest fallback (Chen), (2) metric + alert (Rae), (3) console toggle & warning (Jo), (4) backfill plan (Chen+Rae) to remap last 3h events if mapping logic can be derived.
Chen: backfill plan: dry-run to compute remap candidates first, then staged apply to avoid invoice churn. Will upload diff report to S3.
Jo: rollout gating: add preflight: simulate canary mapping against live small sample and run projection diff. If unmapped_rate > 0.5% -> auto-hold. Proposed rollout config snippet:
```
rollout_checks:
  - metric: metering.quota.unmapped_rate
    window: 600
    threshold_pct: 0.5
    action: hold
```
Rae: will add dashboard card and pager config. Suggest pager only at >2% for 5m; notify slack at 0.5% for ops watch.
canary-bot: canary paused for route-routing-policy:v2 (cr-2026-03-22-010) - hold reason: unmapped quota spike detected
Jo: thanks team. We'll merge the ingest fallback to canary branch, keep canary paused until metric <0.1% for 30m, then resume with stricter gating.
Rae: logging this to rollout playbook: \"always include unmapped bucket and metric before routing changes\". Closing thread; will post PR + S3 diff here.
